EMERGENCY_GENERIC.en: Emergency services have been or should be called. Follow the instructions of the responders.
EMERGENCY_GENERIC.ar: تم أو يجب الاتصال بخدمات الطوارئ. اتبع تعليمات المسعفين.
EMERGENCY_GENERIC.fr: Les secours ont été ou doivent être appelés. Suivez les instructions des intervenants.

GENERIC_ROUTINE.en: An Occupational Health nurse will contact you within one working day. Rest and follow the self-care leaflet in the portal.
GENERIC_ROUTINE.ar: ستتواصل معك ممرضة الصحة المهنية خلال يوم عمل واحد.
GENERIC_ROUTINE.fr: Une infirmière de santé au travail vous contactera sous un jour ouvré.

GENERIC_ADVICE.en: No appointment is needed. Follow the self-care advice and contact Occupational Health if symptoms persist or worsen.
GENERIC_ADVICE.ar: لا حاجة لموعد. اتبع نصائح الرعاية الذاتية وتواصل مع الصحة المهنية إذا استمرت الأعراض.
GENERIC_ADVICE.fr: Aucun rendez-vous n'est nécessaire. Suivez les conseils et contactez la santé au travail si les symptômes persistent.

MSK_URGENT.en: Musculoskeletal pain / injury: Please attend Occupational Health today; you have been booked for a same-day review.

MSK_SEMI_URGENT.en: Musculoskeletal pain / injury: Occupational Health will see you within 4 hours. Avoid safety-critical duties until reviewed.

MSK_ROUTINE.en: Musculoskeletal pain / injury: Occupational Health will contact you within one working day.

MSK_ADVICE.en: Musculoskeletal pain / injury: Self-care is appropriate; contact Occupational Health if things get worse.
